reason: Re-opened via packet.js tao 44: the Heshang Gong comment on 知足不辱 (知足之人絕利去欲，不辱於身) and on 可以長久 (人能知止足則福祿在己，治身者，神不勞；治國者，民不擾，故可長久) are at the place named and verbatim as the evidence gives them (the ellipsis drops only 人能知止足則福祿在己, which does not change the sense). The contented person cuts off profit and puts away desire; lasting long follows (故) from an unwearied spirit in governing the self and undisturbed people in governing the state, which the corrected wording carries without drift. Key verse is the whole of unit 3, whose lines are 知足不辱，知止不殆，可以長久. Plain sense (a chapter weighing fame and wealth against life closes with counsel) is faithful to day.js. verse.js ok (ref Tao Te Ching 44, at [43]); entry-check ok at 45 words, one semicolon.
